search.description: 多条件模糊查询：关键字按包含匹配，部门精确，两者都可选
sql: AND (#1 IS NULL OR user_name LIKE #1)   -- [1] like keyword 姓名模糊，自动转义
AND (#2 IS NULL OR dept = #2)           -- [2] string dept 部门

searchPrefix.description: 同一个条件换成前缀匹配，可走索引
sql: AND (#1 IS NULL OR user_name LIKE #1)   -- [1] likeprefix keyword 前缀匹配
